articles.title: The Only Three Distinctions Between People
articles.highlight: 我们的认知遗产，是一种不安的渴望：要弄清事物如何彼此相连、各自归于何处。
articles.summary: 文章从意识如何从混沌中筛出相关之物、把世界解析为概念谈起，指出人类天生渴望理解事物如何连贯、如何归类，并用法律、标签、层级和类别赋予其形状。这种分类本能曾带来音乐、行星运动定律和民主，也潜藏在各种“主义”之下。它值得读，是因为它提醒我们：分类既是认知工具，也可能成为遮蔽复杂性的框架。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：分类本能能创造秩序，也会把复杂世界简化成标签；做判断时要区分工具性分类与真实结构。
articles.sourceExcerpt: It may be that consciousness evolved to sieve the relevant from the incomprehensible allness of all there is, to parse the world into concepts and find an organizing principle for the chaos of them. Our cognitive inheritance is a restless yearning to fathom how things cohere and where they belong, a yearning we have given shape to in laws and labels, weights and balances, hierarchies and categories. It has served us well, this instinct to categorize in order to contain, giving us music, the laws of planetary motion, and democracy.

articles.title: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该项目是 GitHub 上获得 2962 stars 的开源 AI 会议纪要应用，强调会议内容留在本机、不使用会议机器人，并支持 Mac、Windows 和 Linux。它把自己定位为 Granola、Otter 和 Fireflies 的替代品，值得关注的是其“隐私优先、跨平台、免费开源”的产品取舍。
articles.failureAnalysis: 最大风险在需求与分发：会议纪要已是拥挤赛道，Otter、Fireflies 等已有品牌和集成优势，开源免费本身不保证获客。其次，本地 AI 意味着对设备算力、安装包体积和跨平台工程维护要求更高，且免费开源需要可持续的维护与商业模式。隐私卖点还必须经得起安全审计与合规说明，否则难以转化为企业采购。

en.highlight: Private AI meeting notes stay on your computer without a meeting bot, and the project is free and open source for Mac, Windows and Linux.
en.summary: This is an open-source AI meeting-notes project with 2,962 GitHub stars that emphasizes keeping meeting content on the local computer, avoiding meeting bots, and supporting Mac, Windows and Linux. It positions itself as an alternative to Granola, Otter and Fireflies, making its privacy-first, cross-platform, free and open-source trade-offs worth examining.
en.failureAnalysis: The main risks are crowded demand and distribution, since established meeting-note products already have brand and integration advantages. Local AI also raises device-performance, packaging and cross-platform maintenance costs, while a free open-source project still needs a sustainable maintenance and business model.
en.title: Yogurt: an open-source tool that keeps AI meeting notes local
